Game Overview

In Deep in the Lab - Chapter 1, the core idea is straightforward: brace yourself for a spine-chilling journey through a deserted laboratory crawling with alien foes. In this 2D survival horror, navigate treacherous corridors, solve haunting puzzles, and manage scarce resources wisely. Will you escape the five eerie floors or succumb to the relentless terror lurking in the shadows?
